CAN_AO_PROBE_POWER.title: CanAo Probe Power
STAR_POWER.title: Star
STAR_POWER.description: Temporary resource. Cleared at end of turn.
MOON_POWER.title: Moon
MOON_POWER.description: Temporary resource. Cleared at end of turn.
FENG_WEI_POWER.title: FengWei
FENG_WEI_POWER.description: Increases [gold]Star-Moon Strike[/gold] damage and [gold]Block[/gold] by 1 per stack. Can be negative.
FENG_YAN_BU_XI_POWER.title: FengYan BuXi
FENG_YAN_BU_XI_POWER.description: Your [gold]YuHuo[/gold] cards trigger 1 extra time per stack.
YU_HUO_BANNER_POWER.title: YuHuo War Banner
YU_HUO_BANNER_POWER.description: After each successful [gold]YuHuo[/gold] trigger, gain {Amount} temporary [gold]Strength[/gold].
TEMPORARY_FENG_WEI_POWER.title: Temporary FengWei
TEMPORARY_FENG_WEI_POWER.description: A [gold]FengWei[/gold] adjustment that lasts for this turn.
PAN_XUAN_POWER.title: Circling Guard
PAN_XUAN_POWER.description: Whenever you generate a [gold]Star-Moon Strike[/gold] this turn, gain {Amount} [gold]Block[/gold].
TIAN_FENG_JUN_ZHEN_POWER.title: Heavenly Phoenix Formation
TIAN_FENG_JUN_ZHEN_POWER.description: Whenever you generate a [gold]Star-Moon Strike[/gold], deal {Amount} damage to ALL enemies.
DI_GUO_YU_WEI_POWER.title: Imperial Majesty
DI_GUO_YU_WEI_POWER.description: The first time you play an [gold]Edict[/gold] each turn, gain {Amount} [gold]FengWei[/gold].
TIAN_FENG_XING_TAI_POWER.title: Heavenly Phoenix Form
TIAN_FENG_XING_TAI_POWER.description: At the start of your turn, add {Amount} [gold]Edict[/gold] to your [gold]Hand[/gold].
XING_YUE_WANG_GUAN_POWER.title: Star-Moon Crown
XING_YUE_WANG_GUAN_POWER.description: The first {Amount} times you gain [gold]FengWei[/gold] each turn, gain 1 [gold]Star-Moon Strike[/gold].
ZUI_HOU_YI_WU_POWER.title: Final Dance
ZUI_HOU_YI_WU_POWER.description: At the end of your turn, lose {Amount} HP for each card in your [gold]Hand[/gold].
BU_SI_FENG_QU_POWER.title: Undying Phoenix
BU_SI_FENG_QU_POWER.description: The next time you would die, keep 1 HP instead.
FU_BI_POWER.title: Restoration
FU_BI_POWER.description: Temporary [gold]FengWei[/gold] does not count this turn.
GUI_YIN_YUN_SHAN_POWER.title: Retreat to the Fallen Mountain
BU_DUO_POWER.title: Unfallen
BU_DUO_POWER.description: The first {Amount} [gold]Star-Moon Strikes[/gold] you play each turn are unaffected by negative [gold]FengWei[/gold].
FENG_HUN_POWER.title: Phoenix Soul
FENG_HUN_POWER.description: The first {Amount} times a card is [gold]Exhausted[/gold] each turn, draw 2 cards.
JIAO_HUI_POWER.title: Twin Radiance
JIAO_HUI_POWER.description: Gain {Amount} [gold]Star[/gold] at the start of even turns, or {Amount} [gold]Moon[/gold] at the start of odd turns.
SHOU_QUE_POWER.title: Deficit Guard
SHOU_QUE_POWER.description: At the end of your turn, retain up to {Amount} [gold]Star[/gold] and {Amount} [gold]Moon[/gold].
DENG_JI_POWER.title: Enthronement
DENG_JI_POWER.description: At the start of your turn, look at the top 2 cards of your [gold]Draw Pile[/gold] and [gold]Exhaust[/gold] 1 of them. If a [gold]YuHuo[/gold] card was Exhausted, draw {Amount} cards.
FENG_HUO_JUN_XIE_POWER.title: Phoenix Arsenal
FENG_HUO_JUN_XIE_POWER.description: At the start of your turn, add {Amount} [gold]Fire Blades[/gold] to your [gold]Hand[/gold].
FENG_HUO_JUN_XIE_UPGRADED_POWER.title: Phoenix Arsenal+
FENG_HUO_JUN_XIE_UPGRADED_POWER.descript: At the start of your turn, add {Amount} [gold]Fire Blades+[/gold] to your [gold]Hand[/gold].
ZHONG_ZHANG_POWER.title: Final Chapter
ZHONG_ZHANG_POWER.description: While you have exactly 1 card in your [gold]Hand[/gold], it costs {Amount} less.
WA_MO_YUAN_ZHENG_POWER.title: Expedition
WANG_ZUO_GU_MING_POWER.title: Throne of Solitude
WANG_ZUO_GU_MING_POWER.description: At the end of your turn, if your [gold]Hand[/gold] is empty, gain {Amount} [gold]FengWei[/gold].
BU_MIE_WANG_CHAO_POWER.title: Eternal Dynasty
BU_MIE_WANG_CHAO_POWER.description: At the start of your turn, add a random Attack or Skill from your [gold]Discard Pile[/gold] to your [gold]Hand[/gold].
WAN_BANG_LAI_CHAO_POWER.title: Tribute of Nations
WAN_BANG_LAI_CHAO_POWER.description: At the start of your turn, add {Amount} random {Amount:plural:Power|Powers} from other characters to your [gold]Hand[/gold]. They gain [gold]Ethereal[/gold].
NEXT_TURN_STAR_POWER.title: Moonlit Starforge
NEXT_TURN_STAR_POWER.description: At the start of your next turn, gain 2 [gold]Star[/gold].
XING_YUE_LUN_ZHUAN_POWER.title: Star-Moon Cycle
XING_YUE_LUN_ZHUAN_POWER.description: When you generate your 2nd [gold]Star-Moon Strike[/gold] each turn, gain {Amount} [gold]Energy[/gold].
